name: GeoAlgeria: Algerian Administrative Divisions
description: Dataset of Algeria's 69 wilayas, 556 dairas, and 1,541 commune records with bilingual names (Arabic/French), postal codes, geographic coordinates, and official administrative codes. Updated for the 2025 reform (Law 26-06, JO No. 25, April 5, 2026).
usageInfo: The compilation of wilayas, dairas, communes, their names, postal codes and administrative codes is MIT. Two OpenStreetMap-derived parts are ODbL 1.0, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors: the 69 wilaya boundary polygons in data/geojson/wilaya-boundaries.geojson, and 62 commune centre coordinates taken from the commune's own admin_level=8 relation, 56 from its admin_centre node on 2026-09-27 and 6 from the relation centroid in version 2.1.0, wherever those values appear. Per-part attribution is in the package NOTICE file.
measurementTechnique: Official sources: ONS Code Géographique National 2021, JORA, Algérie Poste BaridiMap (baridimap.poste.dz), Law 19-12 (2019), Law 26-06 of 4 April 2026 (Journal Officiel n° 25, 5 April 2026); OpenStreetMap administrative relations for the wilaya boundary polygons and for 62 commune centre coordinates
citation: Loi n° 26-06 du 4 avril 2026 relative à la nouvelle organisation territoriale du pays, Journal Officiel de la République Algérienne n° 25 du 5 avril 2026. https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/2026/F2026040.pdf
OpenStreetMap: administrative boundaries (boundary=administrative, admin_level=4) in Algeria, ODbL 1.0 ((c) OpenStreetMap contributors), retrieved 2026-06-21
OpenStreetMap: commune relations (admin_level=8) and their admin_centre nodes in Algeria, ODbL 1.0 ((c) OpenStreetMap contributors), retrieved 2026-09-27
variableMeasured: Post office and ATM locations (Algérie Poste)
